points.description: Names the two phases of TCP congestion control as slow start and congestion avoidance.

Slow start: cwnd is increased by one segment per acknowledgement, so it grows exponentially (roughly doubling each RTT), until cwnd reaches ss_thresh or a loss occurs. Equivalent wording earns the mark.

Congestion avoidance: cwnd grows more slowly, roughly linearly (about +1 per RTT, i.e. after all outstanding segments are acknowledged), once cwnd is at or above ss_thresh. Equivalent wording and alternative growth strategies earn the mark.
On packet loss in either phase, ss_thresh is set to half of cwnd (cwnd/2) and cwnd is reset to 1.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both phases named, the exponential-growth behaviour of slow start, the slower (linear) growth of congestion avoidance once cwnd reaches ss_thresh, and the loss response (ss_thresh = cwnd/2, cwnd = 1). Each of the four ideas is worth a quarter mark; a student who gets three of these four ideas earns 0.75, and a student who omits the phase names or the loss response loses that quarter mark. Do not require the model answer's exact wording.
